facts.fact: The National Population Commission announced the full commencement of digital registration of births and deaths across Nigeria under the electronic civil registration and vital statistics system, in effect from 1 July 2026, on its chairman's account.
facts.system: Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (E-CRVS) system

facts.fact: Digital registration of births and deaths took effect on 1 July 2026 and the Commission's chairman says the platform is operational in all 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory, building on the system's launch by the President on 8 November 2023.
facts.system: Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (E-CRVS) system

facts.fact: The Commission's chairman says it has established 4,011 functional registration centres across the 774 local government areas and is expanding to about 8,000; the document does not say how many of them register on the platform. Undated, so the publication date is used.
facts.system: Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (E-CRVS) system

facts.fact: The Commission's chairman describes the platform as online with 24-hour access, automated data validation and a secured foundational database for other national data systems; where the entry is made is not stated. Undated, so the publication date is used.
facts.system: Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (E-CRVS) system

facts.fact: The Commission's chairman says the platform is operated under a public-private partnership with Bankforte Technologies Limited, the Commission's technical partner for cybersecurity, continuous availability and technological support; undated, so the publication date is used.
facts.system: Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (E-CRVS) system

facts.fact: The National Population Commission announced and runs the registration and its centres, in partnership with ALGON, NIMC, UNICEF and Bankforte to decentralise birth registration; a National Coordination Committee on CRVS was inaugurated by the President on 8 November 2023. Undated, so the publication date is used.
facts.system: Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (E-CRVS) system

facts.fact: On funding the Commission's chairman says only that fees for specialised services such as record modification, reissued certificates, attestations and verification were reviewed to sustain the platform, with birth registration and notification highly subsidised; no budget line or donor sum is given. Undated, so the publication date is used.
facts.system: Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (E-CRVS) system
